# Mote geometry

Shape and expression geometry from https://github.com/metaforismo/mote-studio at c299424bb192e5eb8720ad6dd8b1b75eaf19c5c7 (MIT).

Only `packages/core/src/shapes.ts` and `eyes.ts` are included. Geometry is unchanged; the local import uses the Jaz alias. VoiceVisualizer owns the voice-specific choreography using the existing Motion dependency.
